disposition: cited green tea and fatigue rating
assessment: Green tea is cited for a separate stress study. The assigned aromas were black pepper, ginger and solvent. The recorded fatigue VAS supplies no brewed green tea contrast.

disposition: other spices listed as constituent sources
assessment: Oregano, thyme, cinnamon and cloves are named as sources of beta-caryophyllene in the discussion. The assigned aromas were black pepper, ginger and solvent. No whole herb or spice from that list was assigned.
The authors summarize prior black pepper oil inhalation and reflexive swallowing work. Their own calculation task records autonomic stress and subjective impressions without a swallowing assessment.
The pain results in the discussion come from a separate topical combination of black pepper, marjoram, lavender and peppermint. This trial's own endpoint is acute stress during calculation.

disposition: ginger aroma and cited pain reports
assessment: Ginger essential oil was an inhaled comparison for cardiac response and irritation during a calculation task. Pain results in the introduction come from separate massage or extract studies.

Ginger aroma reduced selected acute cardiac response contrasts. Table 3 has no clear condition difference for subjective nervousness. Measurements in male students leave grated ginger and Parkinson anxiety unresolved.
The 29-person analysis estimates added ground pepper against the same culinary turmeric background. The repeated pain comparison gave p=.157. This is the already assessed PMID41599836.

Pain decreased over study weeks while both sequences received ground turmeric. The design randomized timing of added pepper and had no turmeric-free comparison, so it leaves the change attributable to turmeric unresolved.
Ginger and cinnamon appear in background citations on pain. The trial administered turmeric throughout and added ground black pepper during one period.
The formula includes black pepper and eleven other botanicals. The four-week PSQI comparison with cannabis oil and lorazepam was inconclusive (p=.27). This is PMID41623556 already assessed.

The mixture contains Piper nigrum and Zingiber officinale. The sleep trial's adverse-event table groups palpitations and muscle pain under two affected participants. It supplies neither a separate severity rating nor a single-ingredient contrast.

disposition: ginger in sleep mixture and rationale
assessment: Zingiber officinale is one of twelve assigned botanicals. The article discusses anxiety and phytochemical rationale. It reports sleep quality and general adverse events without a clinical ginger-specific anxiety contrast.

disposition: nutmeg and nigella in sleep mixture
assessment: The capsule includes Myristica fragrans and Nigella sativa. The clinical scale measures sleep quality. The trial gives no depression result for either ingredient.

disposition: nutmeg and nigella included in clinical sleep formulation
assessment: The PSQI decreased within each arm, and the overall post-treatment comparison gave p=.27. Nutmeg and nigella were two of twelve ingredients used together, with no ground single-spice or Parkinson estimate.

The tomato paste was consumed as served and with meals cooked. The main WCST executive-index contrast and its sensitivity intervals include zero in healthy adults. The existing PMID42193265 row records this comparison.

Dysphagia was present in four of 17 at baseline and three of 14 at follow-up. The study reports a binary symptom in burning-mouth syndrome, with no severity score or paired transition table after topical piperine.
Pain NRS declined by a reported paired mean 1.93 points with a topical piperine rinse in 14 completers. The existing PMID42194750 row identifies the uncontrolled series and route.
Capsaicin is cited for mechanism and separate topical oral-pain trials. This case series used topical piperine and its swallowing measure concerns dysphagia presence. No cayenne was administered.
Fresh fig ingestion preceded drooling in a child with a likely acute allergic reaction. The existing PMID32518529 row preserves the absence of challenge or Parkinson symptom severity.

disposition: mango in mixture and different outcomes

disposition: food ingredients and executive tests in mixed intervention
